verdict: Organic visibility dropped sharply; paid channels remain off this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google, so your practice relied entirely on organic channels for inbound activity. Google Business Profile delivered 231 total actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — but that signal has weakened significantly, with GBP activity falling 40% week-over-week and the last three days registering zero actions. Search visibility dropped sharply as well, with search clicks down nearly 71% week-over-week, which is being investigated now as a priority. Your pipeline shows 104 opportunities created this period, but no appointments or wins are recorded, so we are working to confirm whether intake follow-through is functioning as expected. Several account milestones due this month are being resolved in parallel to give you a clear, trustworthy picture heading into the next decision window.
